caption:
Why does your dog tilt their head?

The AKC says there is no one answer. Here are three ideas.

1. It may help them find where a sound comes from.
2. It may help them see your face past their muzzle.
3. It often comes before a treat or a walk, so they may keep doing it.

Does your dog do the head tilt? Tell us below.

slides.title: Why does your dog ==*tilt*== their head?
To find where a ==*sound*== comes from.
slides.body: A small tilt may help their ears work out where a noise is.

slides.title: To see your ==*face*== past their muzzle.
slides.body: Their snout can block part of the view. A tilt may help them see you.

slides.title: Because it gets a ==*treat*==.
slides.body: It often comes before a treat or a walk, so they may keep doing it.
